_说明: 怎么填：本文件是 JSON 对象，只认两个键——「_说明」（加载器忽略的说明数组）与「rounds」（对话轮次数组）。
合法 speaker 只有两个：「晷」与「我」，其他值不识别（该轮会被跳过并告警）。
同一 speaker 连续多句=合并为一轮多 texts，玩家连点多次逐句走完再切下一角色；来回交替、长度不限。
本文件不控制立绘：对话立绘=晷，按关卡由游戏内常量映射定档，对话期间锁死。
示例一条：{"speaker":"晷","texts":["到了再讲。","远些，走得稳。"]}
英文字段（2026-11-01 增补）：每轮可选「speaker_en」（"Gui"/"I"，与 speaker 一一对应）与「texts_en」（与 texts 逐句等长、按句一一对应）；英文字段缺失或缺省时回退显示中文 speaker/texts，既有中文字段一律不动。

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 等——这是哪儿？刚才还站着，一眨眼，满天是光。
texts_en: Wait—where is this? One moment I was standing, and the next, the sky was all light.

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 在路上。
texts_en: On the road.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 哪儿的路上？
texts_en: The road to where?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 到了再讲。
texts_en: You'll know when we arrive.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 那你——怎么突然变了个大样？
texts_en: Then—how did you change so completely?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 形貌于我，本就不是死物。真的、画的、大的、小的，都是我。这一身，我偏爱。
改了好几处呢。这儿添条飘带，那儿缀一枚……
（一顿）算了，这些你听了也白听。
texts_en: A form is no fixed thing to me. Painted, drawn, great or small—each one is me. This one, though, I favor.
I've altered it in several places. A ribbon added here, an ornament fastened there...
(a pause) Never mind. Such talk means nothing to you yet.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 你的模样，还能说改就改？
texts_en: You can change your appearance just like that?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 能。要论赶路，还是这一身稳当——真人的皮相，走长了，是有些沉。
texts_en: I can. And for the road, this one travels best—a real body's skin grows heavy over long distances.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 行，那说正经的。带我去干什么？
texts_en: Fine. Let's get serious, then. What are you taking me for?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 找一个人。找到他，是我的正事。
texts_en: To find someone. Finding him is my proper charge.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 谁？
texts_en: Who?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 还不确定，是不是你。
texts_en: Not yet certain if it is you.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 一个字都不给？
texts_en: Not even one word?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 不给。记着——若你不是他，我原样送你回去，抹掉这一路。你不会少任何东西，只当一场梦。
texts_en: Not one. Remember this—if you are not the one, I will send you back as you were and erase this whole journey. You will lose nothing; you will take it for a dream.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 都要抹我记忆了，一个名字还舍不得？
texts_en: You'll erase my memory anyway, yet you grudge me a single name?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 正因要抹，才不能说。记忆未必删得尽，捞回只言片语，反受其扰。
texts_en: Precisely because it must be erased, it cannot be spoken. Memory is not always wiped clean—a stray phrase fished back up only troubles the mind.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: ……想得真远。
texts_en: ...You think of everything.

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 远些，走得稳。
还有一桩，先交个底。
texts_en: Foresight keeps the road steady.
One more matter. Let me be frank from the start.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 嗯？
texts_en: Hmm?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 我的模样，我自己改得；那个人，也改得。
texts_en: I may shape my own appearance—and so may that person.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 他凭什么改你？
texts_en: By what right could he change you?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 这一身，本就是他身上的东西，散出来、凝成的形。硬要说，像他身边一个使唤人。
所以——若你真是他，往后我的模样，你也改得。
texts_en: This form is made of what was his, gathered and condensed. Call it, if you must, the shape of a servant at his side.
So—if you truly are him, then hereafter my appearance will be yours to shape as well.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 改你？
texts_en: Change you?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 改我。不过不急，往后有的是机会试。
texts_en: Change me. There is no hurry—there will be time enough to try.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 凭什么把我卷进来？
texts_en: Why drag me into this?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 有人给我留了线索。时间、地点，写得极细。
细到我去的那一日、那一步，正好听见你一句自言自语。
texts_en: Someone left me a clue. The time and place, written out in fine detail.
So fine that on that very day, at that very step, I heard you murmur to yourself.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 我说什么了？
texts_en: What did I say?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: “总觉得丢了什么。”一句不多，一句不少。
那一眼起，我心里就有数了——多半是你。
texts_en: “I always feel I've lost something.” Not a word more, not a word less.
From that glance on, I knew in my heart—it was most likely you.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 多半？
texts_en: Most likely?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 留两分余地，总没错。
texts_en: Leaving a little room for doubt never hurts.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 就凭这些？
texts_en: On just that?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 够我把你带上。错了也不打紧——退回去，换个时间地点，再走一趟便是。
texts_en: Enough to bring you along. And if I am wrong, no matter—go back, pick another time and place, and make the journey again.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 那你也不急？
texts_en: So you're not in a hurry?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 急什么。时间在我这儿，是路，不是墙。
texts_en: What is there to rush? For me, time is a road, not a wall.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 那你倒说说，我怎么才算他要找的人？
texts_en: Then tell me—how would I count as the one he seeks?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 看他身上的本领，你使不使得出来。
texts_en: By whether the craft that lives in him will answer to your hands.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 什么本领？
texts_en: What craft?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 那人有个本领，世代传承的，叫「锐眼」。
木料该从何处下刀，卯眼开在哪一处，构件怎么咬合——不必人教，一眼便知。
texts_en: That person bore a craft, passed down through generations, called the Keen Eye.
Where to set the blade on timber, where to cut the mortise, how the members lock together—no one teaches it; one glance is enough.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 一眼便知？
texts_en: Known at a glance?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 你身上应该也有，但像是还没长开——使一回，得费你不少力气。
texts_en: You should carry it too, but it seems not yet full-grown—each use will cost you no small effort.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 费什么？
texts_en: Costs what?

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: 天赋。你身上还留着些底子，够你试着使几回。接成一回，天赋就回来一分；回来一分，你就多想起一分。
texts_en: Talent. Some foundation still remains in you—enough to try a few times. Each finished joint returns a measure of it; each measure returned, a memory stirs.

rounds.speaker: 我
texts: 善。
texts_en: Good.

rounds.speaker: 晷
texts: ……到了。小心，几千年前的泥，可不好擦。
texts_en: ...We're here. Mind yourself—mud from a few thousand years past does not wipe off easily.
